name: Casper Wallet
description: Securely manage your CSPR tokens and interact with dapps with the self-custody wallet for the Casper blockchain.
author: MAKE LLC
//sideEffects: Lets webpack drop barrel re-exports nothing uses. Without it, importing one name from @libs/ui/components linked that barrel's whole tree — which is how the Ledger transports reached the popup entry that never renders them (WALLET-1381). Listed below is every src module that DOES something when evaluated; a new one that is imported for its side effect and not listed here will be dropped silently.

scripts.build:manifest:v2:firefox: NODE_ENV=production BROWSER=firefox HASH=$(git rev-parse HEAD) node utils/build.js
scripts.build:manifest:v2:safari: NODE_ENV=production BROWSER=safari HASH=$(git rev-parse HEAD) node utils/build.js
scripts.build:manifest:v3:chrome: NODE_ENV=production BROWSER=chrome HASH=$(git rev-parse HEAD) node utils/build.js
scripts.dev:build:manifest:v2:firefox: NODE_ENV=development BROWSER=firefox HASH=$(git rev-parse HEAD) node utils/build.js
scripts.dev:build:manifest:v2:safari: NODE_ENV=development BROWSER=safari HASH=$(git rev-parse HEAD) node utils/build.js
scripts.dev:build:manifest:v3:chrome: NODE_ENV=development BROWSER=chrome HASH=$(git rev-parse HEAD) node utils/build.js
scripts.dev:chrome: npm run dev:build:chrome && NODE_ENV=development BROWSER=chrome HASH=$(git rev-parse HEAD) PORT=3001 node utils/webserver.js
scripts.dev:firefox: npm run dev:build:firefox && NODE_ENV=development BROWSER=firefox HASH=$(git rev-parse HEAD) PORT=3002 node utils/webserver.js
scripts.start:safari: npm run dev:build:manifest:v2:safari && ./convert-web-extension.sh && NODE_ENV=development BROWSER=safari PORT=3003 node utils/webserver.js
scripts.check:casper-sdk-version: node -e "const a=require('./package.json').dependencies['casper-js-sdk'],b=require('casper-wallet-core/package.json').dependencies['casper-js-sdk'];if(a!==b){console.error('casper-js-sdk version drift: root pins '+a+', casper-wallet-core pins '+b);process.exit(1)}console.log('casper-js-sdk versions match: '+a)"
scripts.setup: npm ci && npm run allow-scripts && husky
scripts.ci-check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run tsc && npm run knip && npm run test:coverage
scripts.e2e:chrome:headless:onboarding: TEST_ENV=true npm run build:chrome && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSER=chromium npx playwright test e2e-tests/onboarding-flow --project chromium
scripts.e2e:chrome:ui:onboarding: TEST_ENV=true npm run build:chrome && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSER=chromium npx playwright test e2e-tests/onboarding-flow --ui --project chromium
scripts.e2e:chrome:headless:popup: TEST_ENV=true MOCK_STATE=true npm run build:chrome && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSER=chromium npx playwright test e2e-tests/popup --project chromium
scripts.e2e:chrome:ui:popup: TEST_ENV=true MOCK_STATE=true npm run build:chrome && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSER=chromium npx playwright test e2e-tests/popup --ui --project chromium
scripts.e2e:firefox:headless:smoke: TEST_ENV=true npm run build:firefox && npx playwright test --config playwright.firefox.config.ts

//dependencyNotes: @scure/bip32 and @scure/bip39 are intentionally held at v1 (1.7.0 / 1.6.0 — latest v1). As of casper-js-sdk@5.1.0 the SDK no longer depends on @scure/* directly, but it still pins @noble/curves ^1.9.7 and @noble/hashes ^1.8.0, which the @scure v1 line shares (~1.9.0 / ~1.8.0). Bumping @scure to v2 would pull @noble/curves@2/@noble/hashes@2 and run two copies of the curve/hash primitives side by side (wrong-address risk, no upside). Bump in lockstep only when the SDK/core move off @noble ^1. See WALLET-1330.
